about: P04 POS: the screens whose view changed in the POS v2 build (TICVAI POS Terminal (3).html, 1 October 2026, kept as sources/designs/TICVAI_POS_Terminal_v2.html and out of git: 9.7 MB). v2 is OUR improved version of the client-approved terminal (sources/designs/TICVAI_POS_Terminal_client_approved.html) and is NOT client-approved, so tools/applied/pos-v2-1-october.py imports these frames as provenance designed, status review, with a wireframe.candidate block; the approved prototype block stays. Screens whose view did not change beyond the shared chrome (the F1-F7 function bar, the Bookings rail item, the on-shift timer, the cart's Reserve and Proceed to payment) keep their client-verified approved frame: POS-007, 008, 011, 013, 014, 016, 020, 026, 027. The V2-* entries are views with no P04 screen (journal, cart history, group reservations, the shift management panel, the reserve, experience-builder and annual-pass dialogs): captured for review only; the import script skips them. The four dialogs (V2-NEWRES, V2-RESERVE, V2-BUILDER, V2-PASS) open outside the device frame in headless capture and stay in the manifest's missing list. Every screen signs in (any operator, PIN 1234) and opens the shift; the terminal is the 1620 x 1080 device frame, the screen designer panel beside it is outside the capture. P15 has no view in either build.
caption: POS v2 build, ours, not client-approved (1 Oct 2026)

screens.name: Sign In
screens.view: Opens here: venue co-branding (Ferrari World), recent cashiers four at a time with their last shift, cashier-ID entry, PIN or password

screens.name: Begin Shift
screens.view: Sign in -> 'Continue to float count' -> 'STEP 2 OF 2 · SHIFT OPENING' (eleven denominations, typed or tapped, with the hardware check running beside the count)

screens.name: Till Home
screens.view: After 'Open shift & start selling', or left rail 'Home': the F1-F7 function bar replaces the home hot keys; the KPI tiles drill into the Sales journal

screens.name: Sell — Ticket Catalogue
screens.view: Left rail 'Tickets', with a timed ticket added (Aqua Park · Day Pass, 12:00, two adults and a child, add-ons dialog continued): REFINE chips, availability on each card, On now / Builder / Scan, the cart with the inventory hold, Reserve and Proceed to payment

screens.name: Sell — Timed Entry
screens.view: Tickets -> 'Aqua Park · Day Pass' -> drawer: business date, the entry-slot grid with what is left per slot (12:00 PM picked), guests by ticket type (two adults, one child)

screens.name: Sell — Seat Map
screens.view: Tickets -> 'Pluma Circus · Reserved' -> drawer -> 'Choose date & time' -> 3:00 PM -> section map -> section 103 (seats, with held and sold seats)

screens.name: Payment
screens.view: Cart 'Proceed to payment' (the POS-002 sale): tenders, cash keypad; a split is taken on the tender itself ('Add to split', 'Half'), there is no Split payment tender

screens.name: Held Orders
screens.view: Cart 'Hold sale', then F2 'Recall held' -> 'Held sales' screen (was a modal): parked value, every line in full, Recall into sale / Print hold slip / Discard hold

screens.name: Omnichannel Order & Fulfilment Center
screens.view: Left rail 'F&B' -> 'Loaded Fries' -> cart order type 'Delivery' (four order types: Dine-in, Quick service, Takeaway, Delivery) + left rail 'Queue'

screens.name: Sell — Food & Drink
screens.view: Left rail 'F&B' (category tabs with counts, REFINE chips, Quick service order type)

screens.name: Send to Kitchen
screens.view: Left rail 'Queue' -> partner order DLV-8842 'Send to kitchen' (it moves to Preparing; the guest status board above shows takeaway and quick-service numbers only, never partner, delivery or dine-in orders)

screens.name: Sell — Merchandise
screens.view: Left rail 'Retail' (category tabs incl. Lockers, REFINE chips)

screens.name: Table Service
screens.view: Left rail 'Tables' -> 'Table service': halls (Main Hall, Terrace, Majlis rooms), the plan drawn to scale, status filters, the hall's table list with Seat & order / Recall check / Settle bill / Seat booking

screens.name: Order Queue
screens.view: Left rail 'Queue': stage counts, the guest status board (order numbers only, mirrors the kitchen display), takeaway, partner, dine-in, delivery and quick-service orders

screens.name: Sales journal (no P04 screen)
screens.view: F7 'Sales journal' -> first row expanded (line items, transaction status, Reprint receipt / Email tax invoice / Refund or void)

screens.name: Cart history (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Cart 'History' -> 'Cart history': completed sales on this terminal by day; a row opens Reload this cart / Reprint receipt / Email tax invoice

screens.name: Shift management panel (no P04 screen of its own)
screens.view: Top bar 'On shift' pill -> 'Shift Management': current shift (terminal, start, elapsed), Clock In & Open Lane / Clock Out, shift statistics, the cash drawer with expected in drawer and takings so far, shift history, End Shift & Declare Cash

screens.name: Reservations / group bookings (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Left rail 'Bookings' (F5 'Reservations') -> Emirates Scouts · Troop 7: tickets encoded inactive, deposit paid, balance due, Take payment with Activate all on payment

screens.name: Reservations: encode a confirmed booking (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Left rail 'Bookings' -> Al Noor International School (confirmed, unpaid, not encoded): encode tickets as Inactive (pay on arrival) or Active (prepaid)

screens.name: New group reservation dialog (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Bookings -> 'New reservation': customer or group, contact, visit date, entry slot, adults and children, Tentative (48 h hold, no encoding) or Confirmed

screens.name: Reserve this sale dialog (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Cart 'Reserve' (the POS-002 sale): customer, mobile or email, visit date, note, Tentative (hold for 24/48/72 h) or Confirmed (pay on arrival)

screens.name: Experience builder dialog (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Tickets -> 'Builder' -> 'Design the guest's experience' (visit type, guests, extras, packages)

screens.name: Annual pass enrolment dialog (no P04 screen)
screens.view: Tickets -> Passes -> 'Annual Pass · Family of 4' -> 'Annual pass enrolment' (holders, photo & ID, validity & card, review)
